title: Amaanaa Jalqabaa Jannata Keessatti Cabe
intro: Mee iddoo biqiltuu nagaa guutuu qabu, uumama hundumaa caalaa kabajamee, daangaa tokko qofa kabajuu qabu keessa dhaabbattee yaadi. Xuxxuquun bara baraa waadaa seena, filannoo tokko waan hunda jijjiira, ta’us araarri karaa duubatti deebi’uu bana. Jalqaba dhala namaa irraa eenyutu dubbata?
clues: Rabbiin suphee irraa uume, of eeggannoo waaqaatiin kan na fakkeesse.
Rabbiin malaaykonni akka naaf sujuudanitti ajajetti kabajaan argadhe.
Muka tokko malee hundatti gammaduudhaaf bilisa taʼee, haadha manaa koo wajjin Jannata keessa jiraadhe.
Gorsaa garaa qulqulluu ta'uuf kakate Seexana hasaasaan na gowwoomse.
Muka haraama irraa nyaadhee haguuggiin koo qaanii irraa buqqa'e.
Jechoota tawbaa Gooftaa kiyya irraan baradhe, Rabbiinis rahmata natti deebi’e.

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
